question: What is the name of the DIGI-book launched by NITI Aayog’s Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)?
solution:
Correct Answer **Innovations For You.**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• NITI Aayog’s Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) has launched – “Innovations for You”.
 
• It is an attempt to showcase the success stories of Atal Innovation Mission’s Startups in different domains.
 
• The first edition of this book is focused on innovations in Health Care and soon other sectors shall follow.
 
• The book is a compilation of 45 health tech startups, incubated at Atal Incubation Centres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points:__**

__
 
• ​These startups are leveraging frontier technologies such as AI, IoT, ICT, and others to provide socially relevant solutions to problems like Anemia, Malaria, dental care, mental health, neonatal and child care, and monitoring human vitals, among others.
 
• Innovations for You is an attempt to showcase how young India is slowly but steadily moving towards becoming a world-class leader.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• ​The Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) is the **Government of India’s flagship initiative** to promote **innovation and entrepreneurship culture** in the country.
 
• **AIM** is mandated to create an umbrella structure to oversee the innovation ecosystem of the country and revolutionize the innovation eco-system - touching upon the entire innovation life cycle through various programs.
